analysis.insight_summary: Users are uncertain about how to correctly transfer programs between their computer and a [product_name] controller. There is a need for clear, beginner-focused instructions on compatible cables (RS232, USB, or Ethernet for newer models) and the processes for uploading and downloading programs. Confusion exists due to different versions of products and software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for straightforward, step-by-step guidance for connecting their PC to a [product_name] controller, including advice on which cable to use and how to perform program uploads and downloads.
